steps.title: Housing: extrude the collar
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as housing.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Draw a circle 72 diameter on the origin.

steps.title: Housing: the bore, 42 H9
actions: Hole: Placement = Concentric on the end face, Simple hole, diameter 42, Through All.
Tolerance: in the Hole dialog (or on the drawing) set the fit class H9: hole 42.000 to 42.062. The model is made at the nominal 42; the limits go on the drawing.

steps.title: Housing: chamfer the bore
actions: Chamfer: Distance 1, select both bore edges (a lead in for the shaft). OK. Save.

steps.title: Shaft: extrude 42 d10
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).ipt and save it as shaft.ipt.
Start 2D Sketch on the XZ Plane. Draw a circle 42 diameter.
Tolerance: d10, so the shaft 41.820 to 41.920. Modelled at the nominal 42.

steps.title: Shaft: chamfer the lead end
actions: Chamfer: Distance 1.5, select the circular edge at the lead end. OK. Save.

steps.title: Assemble: shaft into housing
actions: File > New > Standard (mm).iam and save it as fit_clearance.iam.
Constrain: Insert, the shaft chamfer edge to the bore edge, offset 20 (half way in). OK.

Inspect tab > Analyze Interference shows none, because both parts are at the nominal size. The real fit (clearance) comes from the tolerances: use Design tab > Limits/Fits Mechanical to check it. Save.
